{{Short description|German exoplanet researcher (born 1961)}}
[[File:34 Teleskope für den Blick ins All.jpg|thumb|Heike Rauer (r.) with Ruth Titz-Weider]]
'''Heike Rauer''' (born 18 June 1961)<ref>{{Cite web |last=Rauer |first=Heike |title=Curriculum Vitae, Prof. Dr. Heike Rauer |url=https://www.trr170-lateaccretion.de/sites/default/files/2021-07/CV%26Publications_2.pdf |website=lateaccretion.de}}</ref> is a German [[astronomer]] specializing in [[Exoplanet|exoplanets]] and their [[Detection methods for exoplanets|detection methods]]. Rauer has been the Head of the Institute of Planetary Research at the [[German Aerospace Center]] since November 2017. She is also the head of the instrument consortium for the [[European Space Agency]]'s [[PLATO (spacecraft)|PLATO space telescope]], which set to launch in 2026. Previously, she is a member of [[CoRoT]], [[Rosetta (spacecraft)|''Rosetta'']]'s MIRO [[spectrometer]] and the [[Next-Generation Transit Survey|Next Generation Transit Survey]] collaborations.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Heike Rauer - Head DLR Institute of Planetary Research |url=https://www.dlr.de/en/latest/news/2017/20171101_heike-rauer-appointed-head-of-the-dlr-institute-of-planetary-research_24801 |access-date=2023-05-30 |website=www.dlr.de |language=en}}</ref><ref name=":0">{{Cite web |date=2018-11-15 |title=Die nach den Sternen greift |url=https://www.helmholtz.de/newsroom/artikel/die-nach-den-sternen-greift/ |access-date=2023-05-30 |website=Helmholtz-Gemeinschaft Deutscher Forschungszentren |language=de-DE}}</ref> 

Rauer said that her inspiration to follow space science came from the [[Apollo program]], though later in life, due to her dislike of physics in school, she applied to an art college and got rejected. By the next year, that art college accepted Rauer's application, but she declined the offer to study physics in the [[University of Hanover]]. Her doctorate thesis is about plasma [[Comet tail|comet tails]].<ref name=":0" /> Her name is on one of the [[Minor planet|minor planets]], [[10025 Rauer]].<ref>{{JPL|10025}}, {{LoMP|10025|10025}}</ref>
